privacypolicy.hero_subtitle: Transparency in how we protect and handle your personal information
privacypolicy.intro_content: We respect your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how UrbanLife (PT. Urban Digital Media) collects, stores, uses, processes, retains, transfers, discloses, and protects your personal information on urbanlife.id.
privacypolicy.intro_contact: Questions? Contact us using the information at the bottom of this page.
privacypolicy.section_personal_info_content: We collect information that identifies or can be used to identify, contact, or locate you or your device (personal information), including name, address, date of birth, occupation, phone number, email address, bank account details, gender, photo, nationality, and identification documents (e.g., KTP, SIM, or Passport).
privacypolicy.section_personal_info_direct_content: When you use our website, you provide information necessary for our services, such as:
privacypolicy.section_personal_info_direct_item1: Information required to access services, depending on the service you seek.
privacypolicy.section_personal_info_direct_item2: Payment details, including transfer details, amounts, and card/account information for electronic payments.
privacypolicy.section_personal_info_auto_content: We collect technical data during website visits, such as IP address, viewed pages, session duration, and device information.
privacypolicy.section_personal_info_auto_cookies: Cookies: We use cookies to enhance user experience. You can adjust your browser settings to reject cookies, though this may affect functionality.
privacypolicy.section_personal_info_third_content: We may collect personal information from partners and third parties for purposes related to our services or cooperation agreements.
privacypolicy.section_share_info_warning: 🛡️ We never lease or sell your personal information.
privacypolicy.section_share_info_content: We may disclose or share your personal information with affiliates and other parties only for specific purposes permitted by applicable law:
section_share_info_items: Service provision through our affiliates and partners
Emergency situations affecting safety or public interest
privacypolicy.section_share_info_note: Note: We strive to remove personal associations before sharing information when it’s not necessary to identify you individually.
privacypolicy.section_storage_info_content: Your personal information is stored only as long as necessary to fulfill collection purposes or as required by applicable law.
section_storage_info_items: Automatic deletion when no longer required
privacypolicy.section_protection_info_content: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.
privacypolicy.section_protection_info_note: Important: While we strive to protect your data, internet transmission isn’t completely secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security due to factors beyond our control.
privacypolicy.section_amendment_policy_content: We may review and amend this privacy policy from time to time. Changes will be notified through our website, and continued use indicates acceptance of updates.
privacypolicy.section_acknowledgment_content: By using our services, you acknowledge reading and agreeing to this policy. You consent to our data processing practices as described herein.
privacypolicy.section_unspecified_data_content: We may use anonymized data (with all identifiers removed) that cannot be associated with any individual for research and improvement purposes.
privacypolicy.section_marketing_content: We may send promotional messages via email, SMS, or social media. You can opt-out anytime while still receiving essential service communications.
privacypolicy.section_third_party_content: Our website may contain links to third-party sites with their own privacy policies. We are not responsible for their data practices.
privacypolicy.section_contact_content: Questions about this privacy policy? We’re here to help.
privacypolicy.contact_description: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us:
